patch_description: Add a late-continuation active-contact gradient to complement the soft log-distance objective. Near-minimum and near-diameter pairs are averaged uniformly, which reduces sensitivity to a single switching softmax pair and better resolves the nonsmooth packing objective. Also expand the deterministic structured seed portfolio with independently perturbed cube–axis configurations; unrestricted radial motion can then break the symmetric cube/octahedron contact graph while retaining its strong basin.
